identity.message: RCO Identity 2.0.6: the saved appearance comes back after a revive (no more missing head), /coat works over MP shirts, and male pieces with no model were removed (Left Ring 5, Wrist Binding 6, MP Accessories 6, 14, 39, 42, 50, 61).

vehicles.message: RCO Vehicles 0.1.113: cars with a trunk (Ironhorse, Mule, Prairie) open it on foot behind them: the player lifts the lid, the trunk's inventory opens (RSG and VORP, old and new) and its size is set in Config.Trunks; a locked car keeps it shut. Also: the lock key in the config (Config.LockKey), /carreturn and /givekey, and the repair kit and cloth always taken on edited VORP inventories. Update your RCO cars too.

gym.message: RCO Gym 0.0.89: skipping rope: every pass of the rope under the feet is a jump (a pass before the first one used to lose the rep). 0.0.88: new skipping rope minigame (the rope seen side on, it sweeps under the feet); tiredness as a bar, red when worn out, on the load picker and the record board; the horizontal ladder and the rope climb give less experience (Config.Progression.EasyShare). 0.0.87: any human character can train, server ped models too (the muscle on the body stays on the multiplayer bodies). 0.0.86: a set counts only from 5 good reps (Config.Progression.MinReps). 0.0.85: the record board and the load picker take the UI focus. 0.0.83: the exercises' animations play again. 0.0.82: the gym on the map (Config.Blip). 0.0.81: first release. A working 1890 gymnasium in Strawberry: 21 exercises on our own equipment, each with its own minigame; strength per muscle group with the muscle on the body (RCO Appearance, RSG Appearance or VORP Character); fatigue, warm-up and strains; wind for stamina and a harder punch; records, the week's champion and a spotter who can save your rep.
